question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank. 

While most friends __persuaded__ him to choose the career, there were a few who ________ him from doing so.
solution:
The correct option is: **dissuaded.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Persuade" **means to cause someone to do something through reasoning or argument. (मनाना)
